key_insight: A first-principles spin-vibronic model explains the hidden quadrupolar and canted magnetic phases of Ba₂MgReO₆ through cooperative ordering of coupled electronic and vibrational states.
engineering_relevance: The work informs modeling of spin–orbit-coupled quantum materials, rather than AI or perovskite solar-cell engineering.
method: Derive a spin-vibronic Hamiltonian from first principles.
Use the vibronic states that describe RIXS spectra.
Adjust one elastic-coupling scale factor to set the quadrupolar transition temperature.
evidence_signal: The model gives quadrupolar and magnetic transitions at 34.7 K and 19.3 K, versus measured values of 33 K and 18 K, and reproduces antiferro distortion and ferro elongation between transitions.
watch_item: One elastic-coupling scale factor is calibrated; applicability beyond Ba₂MgReO₆ remains to be established.
